The conflict is that ATAP cannot be in the 'last semester used'. If Sem 8 has courses, Sem 7 is not the last. So ATAP in Sem 7 is allowed if Sem 8 has courses. Let's re-read Rule 11: 'Plan it... never in the last semester used (some course must be planned in a later semester)'. If Sem 8 has CS3230 and ST2334, Sem 7 is not the last. So ATAP in Sem 7 is valid. Why did the previous answer fail? 'R11 ATAP in semester 7, the last semester used'. This implies the previous plan had no courses in Sem 8. My revised plan has courses in Sem 8. Let's check prerequisites. CS3219 needs CS2103T (completed). CS3230 needs CS2040S (completed) and CS1231S (completed). ST2334 needs MA1521 (completed). CS2109S needs CS2040S (completed) and Math (MA1521 completed). CS2106 needs CS2100 (completed). CS2105 needs CS2040S (completed). CS2102 needs CS2030S (completed) and CS1231S (completed). The rule says: 'The other courses in the ATAP semester total at most 8 MC'. CS3210 (4) + CS3230 (4) = 8MC. This fits exactly. So Sem 7: CP3880, CS3210, CS3230. Sem 8: ST2334.
